name: Rhode Island
standard: ADA Title II floor (WCAG 2.1 AA); the only state policy found is the 1999 IRMB Universal Website Accessibility policy (WCAG 1.0 Priority 1 / Section 508)

laws.summary: Creates the Division of Enterprise Technology Strategy and Services (ETSS), which runs state IT and digital services; it sets no accessibility standard itself.

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

policy_docs.title: RI.gov accessibility / Universal Website Accessibility policy (IRMB, approved 1999-01-21)

applies_to: All state websites and agencies under the 1999 policy; local governments via the ADA Title II floor.

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: 1999 policy: department name, update date and email contact on pages; HTML preferred, accessible alternatives to PDF
Office of Library and Information Services monitors state sites
mobile: not addressed — the state policy predates mobile apps; only the federal rule covers them.
procurement: No state accessibility procurement clause found.
enforcement: No formal state complaint path found; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: No current RI statute, executive order or ETSS standard naming WCAG 2.x was found. The 1999 policy is obsolete in practice. The § 42-11-2.8 link is from search results and was not opened.
